1.consolidated_definition: Reiniciar, rearrancar. Volver a cargar el sistema operativo de una computadora. Anglicismo adaptado, poco frecuente. Con un precio regular de $79.99, Parallels 3 te permite correr aplicaciones y juegos de PC en tu Intel Mac de una manera virtual sin tener que rebutear tu Mac (Mac User Boricua, 26-06-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Reboot, restart. To reload the operating system of a computer. Adapted Anglicism, relatively uncommon. With a regular price of $79.99, Parallels 3 allows you to run PC applications and games on your Intel Mac in a virtual manner without having to abandon your Mac (Mac User Boricua, 26-06-08)
